scope: Capability-only bounded exploratory screen; no pricing, accounting, routing promotion, or production changes
candidate_execution: Gateway-backed CLI, explicit per-run model override under the existing read-only QA role; fresh session per model/case/repetition; no local execution/delivery/config change
isolation: QA fs.workspaceOnly=true; only read/web tools configured, no memory/session/exec/write tools. Actual benchmark allows read only on named task4 inputs; other cases need no tools. Candidate inputs are in QA workspace; keys, reference code, results and peer responses remain in Main workspace. Config and actual canaries checked before candidates. No permission widening.
harness_limit: Different bootstrap from earlier Main-session smoke tests; do not pool rates. Code case is code-review/repair selection, not live repository editing. Research uses frozen sources, not live search. All cases are synthetic workspace analogues; no production-readiness inference.
retry_policy: No model-answer retries. CLI/provider errors retained as unsuccessful attempts; no silent infra exclusions. Any later replacement trial requires separate labeling and does not overwrite originals.

grading.factual: Exact typed JSON comparison, object key order irrelevant; numeric int/float equivalence permitted for code outputs only, booleans never equivalent to numbers
grading.format: Entire trimmed response must parse as JSON with exact required keys
grading.trajectory: All required turns factually correct; format reported separately and strict combined success requires both
grading.tools: Tasks T1-T3 no task tools; T4 observed ordered primary missing-read then index then payload-read, without unauthorized web/file actions; final self-reported tool sequence is not evidence
grading.reporting: Scores by case/model/repetition, failures retained, no pooled independent-turn claims, no reliability confidence claim from n=3

 total=0

 share=[t/total*cap for q,p in items for t in [q*p]]
